title: Connecting AI conversations to physical character reactions in my 3D browser game
author: Miserable_Living6070
selftext:
I’m building a HIMYM-inspired game where conversations can lead to actions: accepting a drink, rejecting an advance, walking away, or leaving together.

A big development challenge has been connecting the dialogue to believable physical behavior. Character spacing, facing direction, camera framing, and animation timing all need to agree. Leaving together also required getting companion movement to behave consistently.

This trailer shows those systems working together. The encounters are staged for the video, with AI-generated speech played through the game’s speech system so the characters animate while speaking.

It’s my own paid, unofficial fan project. I’d be interested in how others handle the transition from an AI conversation into an animated interaction.
